title: Day 99: FIFA World Cup T-10 Days; CJNG June Attack Surge Peaks; El Sapo Hunt Day 99; Manzanillo Void Day 23
detail: Day 99 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). FIFA WORLD CUP T-10 DAYS (June 1, 2026): The FIFA World Cup 2026 opens in exactly 10 days at Estadio Azteca, Mexico City on June 11 (Mexico vs. South Africa). Guadalajara's Akron Stadium hosts four group-stage matches beginning June 15. Plan Kukulkan's full deployment is now locked in and operational: 20,000 Armed Forces (SEDENA, SEMAR), 55,000 federal and state police, 188 canine units, 2,100 military vehicles, 24 aircraft and anti-drone systems. U.S. special forces embedded training with Mexican military on counter-drone and stadium attack prevention protocols continues through opening day. CJNG JUNE ATTACK SURGE — HIGHEST MONTHLY TOTAL: Homeland Security Today (May 2026) and the comprehensive 2026 Jalisco operation record document June 2026 as the highest-attack month of the entire post-Mencho period — with CJNG conducting its most intense operational tempo since the February 22 retaliation wave. Of 756 documented CJNG attacks across the February–June window, 324 occurred in June alone — more than the prior four months combined. The surge reflects both O3's Grupo Élite territorial consolidation operations and the ongoing Colombian mercenary-assisted offensive in Michoacán's Purépecha Plateau. June 1 opens this peak-violence month with El Sapo still commanding CJNG's military operations from a position at large. CJNG COLOMBIAN MERCENARIES — PURÉPECHA PLATEAU (Day 99, Ongoing): CJNG's 60+ Colombian paramilitary operatives continue operating across the Purépecha indigenous highlands and 10 municipalities (Zamora, Jacona, Tangamandapio, Tangancícuaro, Chilchota, Charapan, Paracho, Cherán, Nahuatzen, Los Reyes). Colombian operatives — including former combatants with battlefield experience from the Russia-Ukraine conflict applying new tactical lessons — are integrated into CJNG's offensive against Los Reyes Cartel and Knights Templar remnants in the Canyon of the Eleven Pueblos / Sierra de los Reyes logging and drug transit corridors. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 99: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's #1 CJNG enforcement target. One day before the Day 100 milestone. No capture, elimination, or credible sighting reported on June 1. El Sapo's continued freedom is the primary outstanding operational uncertainty for Plan Kukulkan's World Cup security posture. Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet has reiterated his capture or elimination before June 11 as its stated top CJNG enforcement objective. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 23: Twenty-three days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9) without a confirmed successor plaza boss at the Port of Manzanillo — Mexico's primary fentanyl precursor import gateway. Intelligence analysts assess El 03's Grupo Élite is managing port operations through a temporary distributed command structure, but the void creates both an interdiction opportunity for Mexican and U.S. authorities and a structural temptation for rival cartels probing for access. JUNE BILATERAL MEETING — PENDING: The next Mullin-Sheinbaum high-level US-Mexico security meeting — confirmed as scheduled for June 2026 at the May 21-22 bilateral reset — has not yet been formally calendared. The meeting is the first post-World Cup framework assessment point and will address the CIAgate FGR investigation (two open lines: federal jurisdiction invasion + possible treason), the extradition framework tension (El Jardinero extradition suspended May 15; Sheinbaum's 'overwhelming and irrefutable proof' standard active), and ongoing CJNG interdiction coordination under the 'coordination without subordination' framework. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 99): Ongoing — two investigation lines continue in parallel. No charges filed as of June 1. SUCCESSION BINARY (Day 99): El 03 (confirmed leader, financial wing, Grupo Élite) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 99: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested Mar 11), El Jardinero (arrested Apr 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended May 15), El Güero Conta (arrested Apr 27), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized since Feb 22.

media.caption: Homeland Security Today: Mexico's escalating cartel violence — CJNG June 2026 attack surge documented as highest monthly total of the post-Mencho period
2026 Jalisco Operation — 756 total CJNG attacks Feb–June 2026; 324 in June alone, the highest month of the post-Mencho period
